The 30 September strategic digest from Moss says Mateo submitted **ticket #8841** for Door 14. It describes drivers on the second shift at Newark being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. It also says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

I'd check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July you told #strategic-pod you'd closed out ticket #8841 for a Detention Summary export and kiosk cache problem. So the digest number may be a reused or mistyped one. I couldn't find the ticket record itself in the files I can see, so I can't confirm which is right. The earlier Hartford status-page incident was a different number, INC-4821.

Your support queue should show the real ID for the Door 14 ticket.
